sourceBehavior.summary: For exact final build 49845030443200410 on monterey, source code roots the running stock slot, backs up and re-verifies the exact 13-partition inactive-slot write set, writes and reads back v29 boot-chain images in profile order, queues the inactive slot, exploits v29 ABL, restores the original slot and then the target-slot backup over fastboot, erases userdata/misc/metadata, and relies on a fully booted Android to mark the original slot successful.

muraPolicy.writeBoundary: Live use is unavailable. The source does not separately confirm slot activation or the reset, accepts either of two unlock indicators, cannot read back the rollback reset, does not read back fastboot restoration, and leaves mark-success to user observation. Mura requires those stricter gates plus hardware qualification, authenticated final-stock recovery, same-unit reconnect identity, and protected-state closure.

confirmations.prompt: Type root monterey. ionstack intentionally corrupts kernel memory and may panic or damage the device.
Type the live phrase overwrite _a or overwrite _b for the observed inactive slot. Interruption can make that slot unbootable.
Type unlock 16476800119700000. The stock unlock behavior erases userdata, misc and metadata.

value.value: Stop. Preserve the untouched slot and backup. Do not alter the other slot or delete browser storage.
At least one stock slot remains bootable or USB Update Mode remains reachable.

sourceGaps: The source has no both-slots-lost recovery path.
Rollback reset and backup restoration lack authoritative readback.
